meta.instagramCaption:
Kya aapki SIP 'Regular' plan me chal rahi hai? You could be losing ₹25 Lakhs! 💸📉

Direct vs Regular Reality:
• Regular Plan: 1% commission deducted every year for the agent
• Direct Plan: 100% of compounding stays in your account
• Compounding Math: On a 25-yr SIP, that 1% difference equals ₹25+ Lakhs!

Check your portfolio today! Follow @techwith.GenZ for real wealth truths.
